title: Man Flees Scene Of Terrifying Accident And Tries Playing Dumb
description:
#news #police #arrest


On August 28, 2022. An officer was on patrol when he observed a white Chevy Tahoe driving at a high rate of speed. After the officer turned on his sirens. The driver continued to travel at a very high rate of speed into a neighbourhood he eventually lost control of the vehicle and hit a car just outside a family’s house, he then fled on foot. Shortly after, officers found him trying to run across the street. He immediately started to question why he was being arrested despite officers finding all his items in the car.
